typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		mve_gkey as long,
		unit_visit_gkey as long,
		unit_nbr as string,
		move_kind as string,
		from_position_name as string,
		to_position_name as string,
		t_put as timestamp,
		t_dispatch as timestamp,
		t_fetch as timestamp,
		t_carry_complete as timestamp,
		t_discharge as timestamp,
		t_carry_dispatch as timestamp,
		t_carry_fetch_ready as timestamp,
		t_carry_put_ready as timestamp,
		dist_unladen as decimal(18,3),
		dist_laden as decimal(18,3),
		rehandles as integer,
		category_id as string,
		freight_kind_id as string,
		gross_wt_kg as decimal(18,3),
		vgm_wt_kg as decimal(18,3),
		equipment_type as string,
		equipment_class_iso as string,
		pod as string,
		pol as string,
		deck_logic as string,
		weight_logic as string,
		usre as string,
		usrf as string,
		arrival_pos_loc_type as string,
		inbound_carrier_mode as string,
		arrival_mode_prelim as string,
		inbound_carrier_visit as string,
		inbound_service as string,
		outbound_carrier_visit as string,
		outbound_service as string,
		carrier_visit_key as long,
		section_factor as string,
		stacking_factor as string,
		special_stow_1 as string,
		special_stow_2 as string,
		special_stow_3 as string,
		imdg_code as string,
		hazard_un_numbers as string,
		hazardous_flag as boolean,
		requires_power_flag as boolean,
		oog_flag as boolean,
		twin_fetch as byte,
		twin_carry as byte,
		twin_put as byte,
		restow_reason as string,
		pow as string,
		berth_id as string,
		container_line_id as string,
		fetch_che_gkey as long,
		carry_che_gkey as long,
		put_che_gkey as long,
		fetch_che_id as string,
		fetch_che_kind as string,
		fetch_che_operator_id as string,
		carry_che_id as string,
		carry_che_kind as string,
		carry_che_operator_id as string,
		put_che_id as string,
		put_che_kind as string,
		put_che_operator_id as string,
		facility_id as string,
		move_date as date,
		from_loc_type as string,
		to_loc_type as string,
		fm_yard_block as string,
		fm_yard_bay as string,
		fm_yard_row as string,
		fm_yard_tier as short,
		fm_yard_parse_fail as boolean,
		to_yard_block as string,
		to_yard_bay as string,
		to_yard_row as string,
		to_yard_tier as short,
		to_yard_parse_fail as boolean,
		row_hash as long,
		{_silver_loaded_at} as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'adani-ct03',
	folderPath: 'silver/moves') ~> source1
source1 filter(equals(carry_che_kind,'ITV') && equals(isNull(carry_che_id),false()) && equals(isNull(t_carry_complete),false()) && (move_kind=='LOAD' || move_kind =='DSCH')) ~> filter1
aggregate1 window(over(carry_che_id),
	asc(t_carry_complete, true),
	startRowOffset: -1L,
	endRowOffset: -1L,
	Carry_CHE_Id_PREV = lag(carry_che_id),
		Event_Type_Id_PREV = lag(move_kind),
		t_carry_complete_PREV = lag(t_carry_complete)) ~> window1
window1 derive(Cycle_Type = iif(carry_che_id==Carry_CHE_Id_PREV && dayOfYear(t_carry_complete)==dayOfYear(t_carry_complete_PREV),
(
iif(move_kind=='LOAD',
iif(Event_Type_Id_PREV=='LOAD','Half Load Cycle','Discharge to Load Cycle'),
iif(Event_Type_Id_PREV=='DSCH','Half Discharge Cycle','Load to Discharge Cycle'))
),
iif(move_kind=='LOAD','Half Load Cycle','Half Discharge Cycle'))) ~> derivedColumn1
select1 alterRow(upsertIf(true())) ~> AlterRow1
filter1 aggregate(groupBy(mve_gkey),
	each(match(name!='mve_gkey'), $$ = first($$))) ~> aggregate1
derivedColumn1 select(mapColumn(
		mve_gkey,
		Unit_Nbr = unit_nbr,
		Facility_Id = facility_id,
		Move_Kind = move_kind,
		From_Location = from_position_name,
		To_Location = to_position_name,
		Carry_CHE_Operator_Id = carry_che_operator_id,
		Fetch_CHE_Operator_Id = fetch_che_operator_id,
		Put_CHE_Operator_Id = put_che_operator_id,
		Fetch_CHE_Id = fetch_che_id,
		Fetch_CHE_Kind = fetch_che_kind,
		Carry_CHE_Id = carry_che_id,
		Carry_CHE_Kind = carry_che_kind,
		Put_CHE_Id = put_che_id,
		Put_CHE_Kind = put_che_kind,
		t_carry_complete,
		t_put,
		t_fetch,
		dist_carry = dist_laden,
		dist_start = dist_unladen,
		Category_Id = category_id,
		Freight_Kind_Id = freight_kind_id,
		pow,
		Rehandles = rehandles,
		Carry_CHE_Id_PREV,
		Event_Type_Id_PREV,
		Cycle_Type
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> select1
AlterRow1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	format: 'delta',
	fileSystem: 'mundra-ct03',
	folderPath: 'gold/dual_cycling',
	mergeSchema: true,
	autoCompact: true,
	optimizedWrite: true,
	vacuum: 0,
	deletable: false,
	insertable: false,
	updateable: false,
	upsertable: true,
	keys:['mve_gkey'],
	umask: 0777,
	preCommands: [],
	postCommands: [],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> sink1
